hero.title: China's Xi keeps Iranian president at arm's length weeks ahead of Trump summit
hero.description: China's Xi gave Iran's Pezeshkian a brief, low-profile audience at the SCO summit, as Beijing seeks to avoid appearing close to Tehran ahead of a high-stakes summit with Trump.

latest.title: Trump says U.S. is not forcing Iran to negotiate after fresh round of strikes
latest.description: U.S. forces completed another wave of strikes against Iran on Tuesday stateside, hitting multiple Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps sites across the country.

latest.title: Bitcoin withstands $90 oil and rising yields while gold slides. A firm dollar is the catch
latest.description: BTC trades choppy as $90 oil and rising bond yields weigh on stocks and gold.

latest.title: Core DAO plans emergency hard fork after validators drew excess rewards
latest.description: Core says the incident is contained and its planned forward upgrade will not roll back the network or reverse previously confirmed transactions.

latest.title: Australia posts second-quarter growth of 2.1%, beating expectations
latest.description: The GDP print will allow the Reserve Bank of Australia room to go ahead with its policy tightening as it seeks to curb inflation.

latest.title: Japanese green tea giant Ito En surges 8%, defying a broad market sell-off
latest.description: Ito En shares surged, bucking a broader sell-off in Japanese stocks following its fiscal first-quarter results.

latest.title: Hugging Face's new duck robot is selling fast. A Chinese chip powers it
latest.description: The colorful "Microduck" robot from HuggingFace's French subsidiary Pollen Robotics has sold more than 10,000 units since launching on Thursday.
